notes: ἐπικαλέσασθαι keeps unto inside its unit and Καίσαρα stands bare: an accusative has no case for an English preposition to realize, so the preposition is the verb's own phrasal government (rule 106's accusative arm).
whereof stays with ἔχω rather than the infinitive, following rule 74's recorded corpus reading of the supplied-object contrast.
ὡς introducing the disclaimer clause takes that under rule 40; s010 τοῦ is emptied by the possessive my, which belongs to μου (rule 20).
